continuity_scope: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves, the 2023 Paramount feature-film continuity only. This pass uses the official Paramount film page and official Dungeons & Dragons film-promotion article; it does not merge tabletop rules or setting canon, earlier films, novels, games, or promotional game statistics unless an item is expressly described as appearing in the selected film witness.

work_or_witnesses.work: Stream Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves at Home on Paramount+

coverage_rule: Include named individual dramatic characters directly named in Paramount's official cast list and given a character-specific film-promotion role claim in the official Dungeons & Dragons article: Edgin, Holga, Xenk, Simon, Doric, and Forge. Classes/roles, species, factions, magic, spells, artifacts, places, Forgotten Realms references, and tabletop game materials remain terms rather than character nodes.
omissions: All names absent from the selected Paramount cast list or without a direct character-specific official film-promotion claim, including parent/child figures and all minor roles.

Tabletop stat blocks, character sheets, game mechanics, dice, items, and supplemental adventure material, which the official D&D article presents as content for use at a table rather than the film witness.
Classes, roles, species, factions, magic, spells, artifacts, places, and Forgotten Realms references as character nodes.
Earlier Dungeons & Dragons films, novels, games, and non-film setting canon unless an item is explicitly identified by the selected source as appearing in the film.
content_cautions: The selected official sources describe a thief, a heist, dangerous events, an opposing rogue nobleman, and a PG-13 action/adventure film. This pass does not reproduce violence, death, imprisonment, criminal liability, or moral diagnosis.

Film-promotion terms such as bard, barbarian, paladin, sorcerer, and druid are not converted into tabletop statistics, gameplay abilities, species, race/ethnicity, body, disability, gender, or real-world occupation claims.
The selected sources do not establish a parent/child relationship record, despite the task's sensitivity prompt; no family, custody, bereavement, or child-development claim is inferred.
Performer credits support casting/role association only. Character ontology derives from the official synopsis and character-role text, not from performers.
uncertainties: Paramount's synopsis gives only the high-level heist premise; the D&D article gives spoiler-free promotional character labels rather than a full screenplay or scene-level transcript.
The D&D article says the film takes place in the Forgotten Realms and lists setting terms that appear, but its adjacent tabletop-lore and supplement material is not imported as film canon.
No individual species/body, disability, race/ethnicity, parent/child, imprisonment, death, or later relationship claim is made without direct selected-film evidence.
evidence_basis: Paramount's official page establishes the 2023, 134-minute film, synopsis, rights holder, and named cast roles. D&D Beyond's official film article supplies the spoiler-free party and opposing-noble descriptors and clearly separates tabletop supplements from the film. No fan wiki or Wikipedia was used.
